integrity: The proof is deductive. It depends on the published free-factor asymptotic and standard Neron--Tate functoriality; no numerical experiment or unproved finite extrapolation is used.
scientific_limitations: The theorem settles the explicit direct-product family \(F(n)\times A(m)\), not arbitrary disconnected complement graphs.
The height statement is for non-torsion points and counts semigroup maps satisfying a height cutoff, not distinct orbit points after collisions.
title: Power-law degree and height growth survives a free-commutative direct factor
